versions.subject: Merge PR #4481 From @mbabinski - Add New DarkGate AutoIt Rules
versions.detection:
selection_proc:
    - Image|endswith: '\Autoit3.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'AutoIt3.exe'
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\KeyScramblerLogon.exe'
        - '\msiexec.exe'
filter_main_legit_autoit_location:
    Image|endswith:
       - ':\Program Files (x86)\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe'
       - ':\Program Files\AutoIt3\AutoIt3.exe'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\Autoit3.exe" OR OriginalFileName="AutoIt3.exe" ParentImage IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\KeyScramblerLogon.exe", "*\\msiexec.exe") NOT (Image IN ("*:\\Program Files (x86)\\AutoIt3\\AutoIt3.exe", "*:\\Program Files\\AutoIt3\\AutoIt3.exe"))
